name: To Valanaar

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist commands the peacekeepers stationed at Valanaar. She is charged with protecting the island's people, while her small garrison faces growing cult activity.
Aonda is a highlander stationed in Shen'dar. After securing a pylon and defending the village from cultists, she entrusts a traveler with her written report for Valennia.
Valanaar lies at the southeastern edge of the island. It is the base of Valennia Stormfist and the peacekeepers who defend the island's people.

A rapidly growing cult is spreading across the island and pressing into settlements and sacred pylons. The peacekeepers once avoided direct clashes, but now Valanaar's defenders must prepare to fight.
faq.q: What is the cult threatening the island?

faq.answer: Shen'dar is a village near a vital pylon on the island. Its people recently repelled cultists to protect the village and pylon, and its leaders keep close ties with the peacekeepers at Valanaar.
Aonda's written report tells of the defense of Shen'dar and its pylon. It warns Valennia that the cult is spreading too quickly for direct conflict to be avoided.
faq.q: What is contained in Aonda's report?

sections.body: After Shen'dar and its pylon were defended, Aonda sends a trusted messenger across the island. The message is bound for Valanaar on the island's southeastern edge. There, the commander of the peacekeepers must hear how quickly the cult is advancing.
sections.title: Dispatch from Shen'dar

sections.body: Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have long tried to avoid open conflict with the cult spreading across the island. Yet the events at Shen'dar mark a change. The cult's influence is growing, and Valennia can no longer hold back from a clash. Her dwindling force must ready Valanaar for an assault.
sections.title: The Gathering Storm

summary: At Valanaar, Valennia Stormfist must face the cult's growing threat. Aonda sends urgent news from Shen'dar, where the village and its pylon were defended.
